q: Why is the 1973 general election called the Landslide Election, Jordskredsvalget?

options.t: Because more women than men were elected to the Folketing
Because many voters voted for new parties
Because the Social Democrats achieved an absolute majority

answerText: Because many voters voted for new parties

da.q: Hvorfor kaldes folketingsvalget i 1973 for Jordskredsvalget?
options: Fordi der blev valgt flere kvinder end mænd til Folketinget
Fordi der var mange vælgere, der stemte på nye partier
da.answer: Fordi der var mange vælgere, der stemte på nye partier

learn.text: The Landslide Election happened because many voters voted for new parties.

q: What change came into force in 2025 regarding free abortion?

options.t: The limit for free abortion was raised from twelve to eighteen weeks
The limit for free abortion was lowered from twelve to nine weeks

answerText: The limit for free abortion was raised from twelve to eighteen weeks

options: Grænsen for fri abort blev hævet fra 12 til 18 uger

q: Which political movement was the Red Stocking movement part of?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2023 and November 2025 exams.

learn.text: After women had begun to come out onto the labour market from the middle of the 1960s, many women in the 1970s demanded more equality as a continuation of this. For example, women in the Red Stocking movement, rødstrømpebevægelsen, fought through political actions for better conditions for women.
